scope: Complete supplied 36-topic semantic delta; selected excerpts, not literal transcript completeness.

supplied_row.Required preserved content: Ordinary modular Cards become temporary Genesis systems, not Black Cards

rows.before_semantic_assessment: 009 retires special Black Cards and leaves an original ordinary-Card contribution unselected. Ordinary prepared Cards already exist.
rows.resulting_change: Selects future ordinary modular Temporary Transduction Systems without new subclass or completed prototype.

supplied_row.Required preserved content: Shared external manifold referenced to cards, not Kaira

rows.before_semantic_assessment: 008 personal Card-assisted manifolds were described as internally anchored. It did not distinguish a shared external composite frame.
rows.resulting_change: Scopes external Card-relative systems separately; preserves internally anchored personal work and six-stage lifecycle.
after_required_fragments: Conceive → Shape → Hold → Resolve → Manifest → Release

supplied_row.Required preserved content: Cards structural anchors owned by system; operator owns basin connection

rows.before_semantic_assessment: 009 ordinary Cards have basin connections, but shared-system structural ownership versus sustainer connection ownership is not established.
rows.resulting_change: Adds structural anchors owned operationally by the system and connections maintained by the sustainer; no legal transfer.

supplied_row.Required preserved content: Fatigue-limited persistence, no arbitrary timer

rows.before_semantic_assessment: Fatigue limits ordinary Transduction already; no selected persistent modular-system duration rule.
rows.resulting_change: Applies fatigue/throughput/competency/Card-integrity limits to persistence; no arbitrary timer or free-energy resource.

supplied_row.Required preserved content: Passive barrier/dome example

rows.before_semantic_assessment: No ordinary modular passive-dome design is selected; older special-Card designs are retired.
rows.resulting_change: Keeps passive dome/barrier as illustration with radius, count, cost and duration unselected.

supplied_row.Required preserved content: Interactive turret operated by third party

rows.before_semantic_assessment: Architect infrastructure exists; no ordinary modular third-party turret implementation is selected.
rows.resulting_change: Separates sustaining practitioner from aim/fire user; no independent basin access, autonomous targeting or free energy.

supplied_row.Required preserved content: Fabrication workstation and one-part system possibilities

rows.before_semantic_assessment: Prepared single ordinary Cards exist; fabrication workstation and one-component shared-system distinction are not settled.
rows.resulting_change: Preserves both possibilities as examples; one-part distinction and first prototype remain OPEN.

supplied_row.Required preserved content: Architect permanent/infrastructure contrast and velis distinction

rows.before_semantic_assessment: Architects already realize external field structures; temporary velis and physical inscriptions have distinct meanings.
rows.resulting_change: Adds portability/infrastructure comparison without making Kaira inventor of turrets or equating velis with Card systems.

supplied_row.Required preserved content: Offload prepared geometry, not operator energy competency

rows.before_semantic_assessment: 008 already distinguishes prepared scaffold from operator-controlled energy; early Card-to-native learning exists.
rows.resulting_change: Applies existing duty to advanced prepared composite geometry and learning bridge; loading, timing, direction and fatigue remain.

supplied_row.Required preserved content: Six occupied basins forbid independent same-basin expression

rows.before_semantic_assessment: 009 already expressly reserves each active ordinary Card basin across interfaces and forbids independent same-basin expression.
rows.resulting_change: Reaffirms settled exclusivity for composites and third-party controls; does not solve activation against running native work.

supplied_row.Required preserved content: Unresolved Card coupling/range/damage/reconfiguration

rows.resulting_change: Lists all new ordinary coupling, range, damage, movement, controls, reconfiguration and prototype gaps separately from retired mechanics.

supplied_row.Required preserved content: `ru’ne` letters/sigils words analogy, discovered math not invention

rows.before_semantic_assessment: Physical ru’ne, sigils and mathematics exist; worldwide natural field-language discovery is not fully established by that owner.

rows.resulting_change: Adds reduction of useful natural relations and compatible two-block spatial locking as engineering illustration.

rows.before_semantic_assessment: No mapped floating island or proven water/levitation mechanism is established for this delta.

supplied_row.Decision / boundary: Kaira's professional contribution: modular **Temporary Transduction Systems** built from ordinary Genesis Cards, not special Black Cards.
Composite Card system's manifold is externally **card-relative**, not practitioner-centered. Cards become structural anchors/components; sustaining practitioner owns active basin connection.
Systems may be interactive or passive and usable by third parties without those users becoming sustaining transductionists. Temporary operation is fatigue-limited.
Active Card occupancy blocks independent same-basin native/bond expression; six disjoint single-basin Cards occupy all six. No bypass.
Architect infrastructure can produce similar constructs; modular Cards are portable, temporary architectural realization, not invention of turret/barrier.
Natural `ru’ne` and sigils form spontaneously throughout nature, transiently or persistently, at complexities humanity cannot fully copy.
Humans discover mathematical relationships and engineer reduced local expressions, e.g. spatial-locking building blocks.
Floating islands and water features may be natural sigil systems; exact physics and actual mapped locations OPEN.
Research parties study natural dungeon sigils; aithren escorts, combat helkir and environmental coherence helkir have distinct operational roles.
Multi-week Blue-stratum research expedition, environmental sustainment and possible eldris battle/rescue by Kaira are potential narrative scenarios, not completed events.
Kaira has exceptional sustained Transduction capacity and can eventually occupy offensive, defensive, restorative, exploration and research roles. Not infinite fatigue.
Black bonds alter/expand Kaira's natural realm-specific intuition/perception; each independent denizen mentors her. Exact physics intentionally unselected.
Blackstone Institution of Knowledge teaches human Cardsmithing; realm-native Transduction learning unfolds through companions and experience, not repeated school arcs.
Kaira's potential is eventually universal across admissible Shapings, but practical knowledge/mastery/fatigue develop over long time.
Seven-book saga culminates in world-local Genesis-field stabilization addressing eldris collapse pressure; starscape-wide stabilization reserved for possible later stories.
Protected word `ru’ne`, not `runae`/`runei`; `Kaira`, `aithren`, `Vaelith`, `helkir` and other current names. Preserve raw dictation only as quoted evidence.

`vaelum` is the protected canonical organization term. The author explicitly corrected the voice-to-text spelling; use `vaelum` in all active prose and records. Preserve the mistaken transcription only as labeled evidence.
LIVE_MODEL_009 retired Black Genesis Card subsystem; nothing in 009B reactivates it.
Arc Two current scene handoff: shirt/backpack/fruit, independent work outreach at dungeon staging; no invented customer, dungeon descent, or completed robe.
